summary: TDH Holdings, Inc., a PRC-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its proxy statement, proxy card, and press release for its 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting, equivalent to a US annual meeting proxy. The meeting will be held November 10, 2026 in Beijing, with a record date of September 30, 2026. Shareholders will vote to reelect Owens Meng as a Class C director until 2029 and to ratify YCM CPA Inc. as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, or advisor is disclosed; watch for proxy-vote turnout and any dissident nominations.
